title: A field should not duplicate the name of its containing class
description: Fields in a class should not have the same name as the class itself. This can lead to confusion and maintenance issues, as it is unclear whether a reference is to the class or the field.
message: Rename the field so it does not duplicate the name of its containing class.
impact: Code readability and maintainability are reduced. It can also lead to subtle bugs if the field is mistakenly used instead of the class, or vice versa.
recommendation: Rename the field to something that does not duplicate the class name. Use descriptive and distinct names for fields and classes.

noncompliant.description: The field 'Person' has the same name as the class 'Person'. This is confusing.

compliant.description: The field 'age' does not duplicate the class name.

why_is_this_an_issue: Having a field with the same name as its containing class makes the code harder to understand and maintain. It can also cause confusion between the class and the field, leading to potential bugs.
how_to_fix: Rename the field so that it does not duplicate the class name. Choose a name that clearly describes the field's purpose.

security_mappings.CWE: CWE-710: Improper Adherence to Coding Standards
